payload.core_mechanism_summary: Checks if diff can be covered by 1 or 2 digit changes using maximum possible increases/decreases (e.g., 9-min, max digit). Uses greedy thresholds: if best single change suffices, answer 1; else check best two-change combinations.
payload.rationale: Solution directly computes min and max changes with 1 or 2 replacements, a classic greedy exchange argument prioritizing most impactful digit changes. No search or sorting involved.
